relations: The hand holding the glass teapot may tilt or move it, causing the dark liquid inside to slosh.
Reflections of the kitchen on the curved glass surface shift dynamically as the teapot's angle changes.
The background stove, pan, and kettle remain stationary while the foreground teapot is manipulated by the hand.
Condensation or steam on the upper part of the teapot may dissipate or shift as it moves.
